Entries.Title: Smoke
Entries.Description: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as the search for suspects begins. Michelle Calderone pumps the brakes on her personal life. Dave Gudsen gets creative.

Episodes.Title: Your Happy Makes Me Sad
Episodes.Description: Seemingly stalled, Gudsen and Calderone consider a new lead. Chaos ensues on a side mission. Freddy Fasano rethinks his future.

Episodes.Title: Weird Milk
Episodes.Description: Calderone charts her own course for answers. Gudsen pitches a new path for their partnership. Freddy heads to Coop's headquarters.

Episodes.Title: Strawberry
Episodes.Description: Gudsen sheds light on his dark past. Calderone digs even deeper. Freddy starts to spiral.

Episodes.Title: Size Matters
Episodes.Description: While Gudsen heads out of town for a conference, Calderone tries to track down his old partner. Freddy seeks revenge.

Episodes.Title: Manhood
Episodes.Description: Esposito and Calderone urge Harvey to take action. A fully rogue Freddy reaches out to an ally.

Episodes.Title: Whitewashed Tombs
Episodes.Description: On the heels of heartache, Calderone clocks in for a covert mission. Gudsen navigates newfound glory—and an unexpected confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Mercy
Episodes.Description: Gudsen flips the script. Harvey grapples with regret. Calderone is forced to confront her past.

Episodes.Title: Mirror Mirror
Episodes.Description: A desperate Calderone calls in a favor. Gudsen scrambles for control. A massive blaze stokes a make-or-break showdown.

Entries.Title: Good Boy
Entries.Description: After 11 years, the police revive their special recruitment for former national athletes. Once hailed as heroes, these world-class medalists now face harsh realities. Despite financial struggles, unexpected tragedies, and discrimination within the force, the athletes, each with their own story, reunite as a special task force to take on major crimes with the grit and skills they honed as athletes.

Episodes.Title: Our Twisted Hero
Episodes.Description: After causing trouble, Dong-ju is demoted to the Insung Metropolitan Police Agency, where he's treated like dead weight and his fellow world-class medalists also face discrimination and scorn. But when a major case erupts, it reignites the fire in their hearts.

Episodes.Title: Faster, Further, Stronger
Episodes.Description: At Man-sik's suggestion, a special criminal investigation team is formed with the former world-class medalists. Ready for a fresh start, each member joins with their own hopes and goals, but behind the creation of this special team lurks a hidden agenda.

Episodes.Title: Million Dollar Baby
Episodes.Description: Convinced that Ju-yeong is the hit-and-run driver, Dong-ju scrambles to find evidence. Meanwhile, Jong-hyeon heads to the Prosecutors' Office at Man-sik's request to investigate Gyeong-il's case, and Ju-yeong meets someone in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Float Like a Butterfly
Episodes.Description: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is now complete with Han-na's return and Jong-hyeon joining. They launch a full-scale investigation into Gyeong-il's death and Min Ju-yeong. As they split into teams and close in on their targets, Han-na receives her father's case files.

Episodes.Title: Punch-Drunk Love
Episodes.Description: While investigating Ju-yeong, the Special Criminal Investigation Team is forced to hand him over to the prosecution after their sudden intervention. Dong-ju is hospitalized for tests following his car accident, and the team digs deeper into Ju-yeong's true identity and his connections to the prosecution.

Episodes.Title: Counterpunch
Episodes.Description: Using Han-na's surprise kiss as an excuse, Dong-ju heads out alone with her on an investigation and discovers Ju-yeong's burner phone. Jong-hyeon finds himself growing uneasy as Dong-ju and Han-na get closer. Meanwhile, Drugmon, under surveillance in an apartment, begins plotting her escape.

Episodes.Title: Par Terre Par Terre
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju's assault puts the Special Criminal Investigation Team in a major crisis. Man-sik fights to keep the team together, while the others continue investigating Ju-yeong, weighed down by uncertainty. Meanwhile, Ju-yeong leaves the hospital and heads to an unknown destination.

Episodes.Title: The Aimless Bullet
Episodes.Description: The Special Criminal Investigation Team catches wind of Ju-yeong's drug smuggling and infiltrates the customs office disguised as a quarantine unit. Following a lead left by Drugmon, they manage to find the container hiding the drugs but walk straight into a trap set by Ju-yeong.

Episodes.Title: Allez
Episodes.Description: Han-na is kidnapped, and Dong-ju and Jong-hyeon rush to rescue her, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly crisis. Just when it seems there's no way out, an unexpected gunshot rings out. With an unforeseen sacrifice shaking the team, will they survive?

Episodes.Title: Time-out
Episodes.Description: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is disbanded in the end. Dong-ju quietly prepares revenge against Ju-yeong alone, but his reckless move only invites a greater crisis. Catching on to his plan, Ju-yeong launches a counterstrike.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: The Special Criminal Investigation Team reunites and uncovers Joo-young's big secret. Frightened by Dong-joo's countdown challenge, Joo-young takes desperate measures. So who will win in the end?

Episodes.Title: Foul
Episodes.Description: Falling into Ju-yeong's trap, Dong-ju suffers a critical injury and faces his greatest crisis yet. Will he push through or fall where he stands?

Episodes.Title: Load, Start...Don't Stop
Episodes.Description: With no way to retreat, Dong-joo and the team launch their final all-out attack on Joo-young. Moving in without hesitation, they soon face a fierce counterattack and unexpected difficulties. What is written in their fate?

Episodes.Title: Kings Never Die
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: On the Ropes
Episodes.Description: The entire Inseong police force unites and launches a massive operation against Joo-young's gang. But just when they are close to victory, Joo-young's most devastating counterattack throws the entire city into chaos.

Episodes.Title: We Are The Champions
Episodes.Description: Amidst the chaos, Dong-joo and Team Inseong begin their decisive battle to determine the fate of the city. Carrying the weight of everyone's hopes and expectations on their backs, will they be able to achieve the ultimate victory and emerge as true heroes?

Entries.Title: Head Over Heels
Entries.Description: A teenage shaman determined to change fate sets out to save a mysterious boy destined to die. As danger looms, their fated encounter sparks a powerful first love that defies darkness and reclaims hope.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Just when the high-schooler shaman Seong-A is getting bored with life, handsome Gyeon-U walks into her shrine upside-down. But he's destined to die?

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seong-A hangs around Gyeon-U even when he's suspected of arson. Another fire breaks out, and Seong-A jumps into the flames. All for one reason!

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Seong-A's the only one by Gyeon-U's side at the funeral. Her mission as a human amulet begins! Holding hands, linking arms - all to fend off the evil!

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: "Let's stay moist," Weird love confession, but the heart flutters! But what if Seong-A's biggest secret is tied with Gyeon-U's deepest wound?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gyeon-U loses trust in Seong-A when he realizes she's something he hates the most. Seong-A loses her human amulet power and wounds open up.

Episodes.Description: Seong-A finds out Yeomhwa relished Gyeon-U's suffering. Seong-A decides to take Yeomhwa head on to save Gyeon-U while he comes across her past online.

Entries.Title: Unspeakable Sins
Entries.Description: A woman in a controlling marriage finds solace — and revenge — in an affair with a younger man, until it spirals into a dangerous fight for survival.

Episodes.Title: The Trap
Episodes.Description: Helena is the perfect wife — until her passionate affair with a younger man spirals into a dangerous scheme to obtain her freedom.

Episodes.Title: The Reunion
Episodes.Description: An argument escalates into a bloody scene. Iván's cover is blown as his trust in Helena wavers. Octavio tries to keep the police investigation hidden.

Episodes.Title: Desperation
Episodes.Description: Octavio is kidnapped by El Magic, who just wants Claudio. As Iván questions Helena's motives, Fer spirals. Octavio makes a startling discovery.

Episodes.Title: Under Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Octavio and Helena clash as Iván learns more about Claudio's secretive parties. Livia reunites with an old flame, and Fer makes a terrible confession.

Episodes.Title: Doubts
Episodes.Description: Octavio fights the clock as he executes El Magic's plan to find Claudio. Iván spins a tale for Pablo, and Livia makes a new online dating match.

Episodes.Title: False Death
Episodes.Description: Iván learns about Helena's dark side. Octavio and El Magic conspire to fool everyone. Claudio faces his captor.

Episodes.Title: The Prosecutor's Fall
Episodes.Description: A phone call gives Livia hope, and Iván's responsibilities catch up to him. When Pablo's secret comes out, he's forced to the edge of reason.

Episodes.Title: The Call
Episodes.Description: Claudio attempts an escape while Livia's suspicions about Octavio are fueled. As Helena recovers in the hospital, another video leaks.

Episodes.Title: Captured
Episodes.Description: Livia and Iván are kidnapped. Sofía turns her eye to Antonio. Rafael worries about a third video leak, and a derelict chapel yields a startling sight.

Episodes.Title: He's Alive
Episodes.Description: Claudio's return threatens to break the Martínezes. Another video leak threatens a high-powered executive. Helena plots a new escape.

Episodes.Title: Extortion
Episodes.Description: Fedra and Antonio adjust their plans as Montero files a claim against Claudio and Helena. Livia meets Rebeca, and El Magic pays Claudio a visit.

Episodes.Title: Secrets of the Past
Episodes.Description: Claudio exacts revenge on his enemies, starting with Helena. Fedra gets close to Octavio. Iván's secret comes out, as Rafael reaches out to Helena.

Episodes.Title: The Scandal
Episodes.Description: Claudio settles a score, and an online leak tears Helena and Iván apart. As Helena and Fer seek refuge in an unlikely place, Livia gets what she wants.

Episodes.Title: Disillusionment
Episodes.Description: Sofía's suspicions raise questions for Livia. Iván and Rebeca get a scare. Rafael and Dora are tested, as Claudio and Fedra have a dicey confrontation.

Episodes.Title: All Against All
Episodes.Description: A police investigation into Claudio's death leads to several suspects. Octavio discovers Fedra's deceit as Livia overhears Iván's shocking confession.

Episodes.Title: Revelations
Episodes.Description: Helena is arrested while Iván and Livia find clues to Fedra's past. El Licenciado plans a hit on Octavio. Fer unlocks a key piece to his past.

Episodes.Title: A Heavy Blow
Episodes.Description: Rafael gives Fer the truth, and Helena conceals it. Iván overhears Sofía and Benítez. Arcadia's revenge claims a life. El Licenciado comes calling.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: As Livia and Octavio face El Licenciado, Helena has one more scheme up her sleeve. Sofía closes a case — but will another one open?

Entries.Title: The Institute
Entries.Description: When 14 year old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won’t last, as his story and Luke’s are destined to collide.

Episodes.Title: The Boy
Episodes.Description: Luke Ellis wakes up at The Institute, a facility that abducts teenagers with psychic powers. Ms. Sigsby, the place's charismatic director, claims they're saving the world. Meanwhile, Tim Jamieson hides from his haunted past as a small-town night knocker.

Episodes.Title: Shots for Dots
Episodes.Description: Luke bonds with the other Front Half residents, begins plotting his escape. Meanwhile, Ms. Sigsby manages the fallout from a security breach. In town, Tim begins to look into The Institute, only to find himself caught up in a high-stakes standoff.

Episodes.Title: Graduation
Episodes.Description: Luke begins to plan his escape while Sigsby is distracted trying to expose Stackhouse's disloyalty. Meanwhile, Tim loses a friend.

Episodes.Title: The Box
Episodes.Description: As Luke's tests intensify, a new arrival causes problems for Sigsby; Tim isn't buying the official story about what happened to Annie.

Episodes.Title: Back Half
Episodes.Description: Sigsby tricks Luke into confirming he's TP, forcing him to move up his escape attempt; Tim's suspicions put him on the Institute's radar.

Episodes.Title: Run
Episodes.Description: As Tim's investigation pays off in ways he never imagined and Sigsby scrambles to avert disaster, Luke must finally decide who he can trust.

Episodes.Title: Hide
Episodes.Description: Luke and Tim go on a desperate search for help as Sigsby uses all of her formidable assets in a last-ditch attempt to keep the Institute's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Fight
Episodes.Description: Our characters come together for a final confrontation with unimaginable consequences.

Entries.Title: Duel on Mount Hua
Entries.Description: «Jin Yong Wuxia Universe» (金庸武侠世界 / The Legend of Heroes) is a martial arts series based on the novels of Jin Yong, with «The Legend of the Condor Heroes» as its main plotline. The series weaves together two dramatic stories – «Hot Blooded» (30 episodes) and «Duel on Mount Hua» (30 episodes), the latter encompassing four character arcs: «Nine Yin True Sutra» (8 episodes), «Eastern Heretic and Western Venom» (8 episodes), «Southern Emperor and Northern Beggar» (8 episodes), and «Five Great Masters» (6 episodes).

However, Seon-ah is a victim of bullying from bullies. One day, when the bullying from bullies reaches its peak, Seon-ah discovers a mysterious pair of glasses in her locker...

Entries.Title: Eşref Rüya
Entries.Description: As a child, Eşref fell in love from afar with a girl he called “Rüya” and spent years searching for her, only to become a powerful mafia figure along the way. Meanwhile, Nisan, an idealistic musician, finds herself in grave danger after performing at a wedding held at Eşref’s hotel. Eşref falls for Nisan, unaware that she is both the long-lost Rüya he has been chasing for years and a police informant. Trapped in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles, Eşref is forced into a brutal reckoning—both with his criminal empire and his own emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Eşref Rüya tells the story of a young man who is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know. Çağatay Ulusoy plays the character Eşref, who is reckless, has everything but is a prisoner of a love whose name he does not know, while Demet Özdemir plays Nisan, the young musician who makes Eşref's heart skip a beat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Nisan, who understands that she is in great danger once again with this incident, looks for ways to escape Çiğdem's games. Eşref cannot help but be carried away by feelings that he is unfamiliar with whenever he comes face to face with Nisan. Nisan's getting closer to Eşref causes alarm bells to ring for both of them. On the other hand, a great surprise awaits İzzet, who is drunk with victory. Eşref, who is preparing to make his enemies experience hell, will also face his new rival on the security front.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After İzzet’s death, Eşref now faces an even greater enemy. Horrified by everything that’s happened, Nisan prepares to make bold moves beyond her limits in order to finally end the game. Meanwhile, with his plans progressing as intended, Kadir is willing to betray the Yetimler to eliminate Eşref from the picture. On the law enforcement side, Serdar investigates the murder at the hotel and comes face to face with Eşref and the tribe. This tense confrontation—where everything could fall apart at any moment—sets the stage for an impending major conflict. Though Nisan plans to throw Eşref into the fire to save herself, seeing a different side of him pushes her into an unexpected dilemma. Her growing closeness with Eşref is about to land her in serious trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Nimet’s abduction of Nisan and Afra signals that the war between the Yetimler and the tribe is far from over. Despite Serdar’s warnings, Eşref and Nusret continue to make moves that only fuel the fire of revenge between them. Kadir does everything he can to turn the Yetimler against Eşref. Meanwhile, his unexpected encounter with Nisan sparks unfamiliar emotions in Kadir’s heart. Eşref’s bold move to rescue Afra catches Nisan off guard. Now caught in a deep moral dilemma, will Nisan be willing to stain her hands with blood—if it means saving her sister’s life?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description:
Kadir's appearance as a rival in his deepening relationship with Nisan upsets Eşref's balance.  Meanwhile, when Nisan's closeness to Eşref draws the attention of the Gürdals, Nisan faces the risk of being exposed.

While Eşref is convinced to end his feud with Nusret, a surprise development leads him to burn all ships. Eşref's final move will not only cause him to throw himself into the fire, but also his loved ones. Nisan will make a move that will shake Eşref's heart in order to prevent her secrets from being revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description:
Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

Kadir, who is doing everything he can to prevent Eşref from coming to power, has started to get closer to Nisan. Will Kadir, who is burning with love and lust for power, be able to risk betraying Eşref, who he promised to always stand by his side?

Eşref, who agreed to confront Nusret Ağa at the point where the Orphans are in danger, will cause the balances to change again with a surprise move that will have an impact in the underworld.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Although Nisan is willing to turn down the opportunity she has for her career for Eşref, bigger surprises await her in the future. When the Yetimler's fight with the tribe begins to disturb the elders of the underworld, an unexpected development occurs for both sides. Meanwhile, Yakup Baba's worsening condition is a sign that there will be radical changes in the Yetimler.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description:
While Eşref tries to protect Nisan on one hand, he also tries to find the identity of the person who betrayed her. While Eşref's absence causes the team to raise the alarm, Kadir, who prepared the plot, secretly follows the events.

Çiğdem enters a big impasse with the move she made against Atıf. She is ready to take big risks to continue her game. While suspicions on Kadir increase, she will do her best to hide her betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Eşref sees with his own eyes that the traitor is Kadir and begins to meticulously plan his next move. Kadir feels that the tension between him and Eşref is increasing and looks for ways to get out of the situation he is in. As Nisan and Eşref continue their turbulent relationship, it will become increasingly difficult to resist the attraction between them. When weapons are drawn against betrayal, those who want to survive will have to act quickly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Eşref threatens all his enemies by killing Nusret. Kadir, who understands the seriousness of the situation, feels that his mask is about to fall. When the time comes to confront Eşref, he realizes that this is his last chance to put everything in order.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description:
Although Nisan knows that there is no room for love in Eşref's dangerous world, she cannot help but dream of a future with Eşref. Eşref, on the other hand, is in shock at feeling such intense feelings for someone for the first time since Rüya.

While the ceremony to be held for Eşref's ascension to power is on the agenda of the orphans, Kadir is in danger of being exposed at any moment. Helpless, Kadir will have to take refuge in Çiğdem's insidious plans. Eşref, who is in a great dilemma between his position in the underworld and his relationship with Nisan, will encounter an unexpected development that will turn his decisions upside down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description:
The journey he embarks on with the hope of finding the love of his life leaves him face to face with his greatest test yet.

Kadir, blinded by his ambition for leadership, tries every way to seize control and is determined to crush everyone in his path. His collaboration with Çiğdem drags Nisan and Eşref into a dangerous conflict.

In this great struggle where everything is turned upside down, Eşref fights with all his might to protect his loved ones. In the season finale where blood is shed, betrayal reaches its peak and the entire order is turned upside down, Eşref will face his nightmare while waiting to be reunited with his Dream.

Entries.Title: Ballard
Entries.Description: Detective Renée Ballard plunges into a web of murder and corruption as she hunts a ruthless serial killer and uncovers a sinister police conspiracy that threatens everything she stands for. With her own demons nipping at her heels, Ballard must outwit both criminals and colleagues to bring long-overdue justice to the victims and their families.

Episodes.Title: Library of Lost Souls
Episodes.Description: Ballard reopens a mysterious John Doe case while pursuing justice for a councilman's murdered sister. As she navigates reluctant witnesses, department politics, and her own demons, Ballard and her team uncover buried secrets that suggest corruption within the police force.

Episodes.Title: Haystacks
Episodes.Description: Ballard and Parker investigate housekeeper Yulia Kravetz's murder. Meanwhile, the hunt for the serial killer's latest victim reunites Ballard with retired Detective Harry Bosch.

Episodes.Title: BYOB
Episodes.Description: The 2006 death of fraternity member Nick Thatcher was initially ruled an accident. When a video goes viral accusing the fraternity of murder, Ballard and her team are forced to reopen the case.

Episodes.Title: Landmines
Episodes.Description: Ballard uncovers an LAPD conspiracy with connections to a Mexican cartel. The Pearlman case heats up when clues lead to a dangerous showdown with a potential suspect.

Episodes.Title: What's Done in the Dark
Episodes.Description: When the team uncovers disturbing new information in the Pearlman case, they focus in on a new suspect.

Episodes.Title: Beneath the Surface
Episodes.Description: Ballard's serial killer investigation takes a high-stakes turn. With 72 hours to secure the case before it's transferred to Homicide, the team races to find connections between the victims.

Episodes.Title: Fork in the Road
Episodes.Description: Bosch delivers a shocking lead in the LAPD corruption case. Ballard and team dive into the mysterious murder of a teenager with ties to a local gang.

Episodes.Title: Last Call
Episodes.Description: The Ibarra case turns personal as Martina discovers someone close to her is part of the corrupt LAPD ring. The team races to identify the remaining corrupt officers before time runs out.

Episodes.Title: Collateral
Episodes.Description: A fresh lead turns into a shocking revelation as the team learns their serial killer has been in their grasp the whole time.

Episodes.Title: End of the Line
Episodes.Description: A city-wide manhunt begins for Rawls's shooter. Ballard receives an unexpected update on the LAPD conspiracy case.

Entries.Title: Ironheart
Entries.Description: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

Episodes.Title: Take Me Home
Episodes.Description: Determined to complete her newest armored suit, Riri Williams teams up with Parker Robbins.

Episodes.Title: Will the Real Natalie Please Stand Up?
Episodes.Description: Riri's new A.I. dredges up painful memories ahead of her first heist with Parker and his crew.

Episodes.Title: We in Danger, Girl
Episodes.Description: Riri is uncomfortable being part of Parker's crew—two more heists, max, and she's out, she promises.

Episodes.Title: Bad Magic
Episodes.Description: When Parker suspects Riri of wrongdoing, she knows she has to figure out the source of his powers.

Episodes.Title: Karma's a Glitch
Episodes.Description: Riri sets out to create a suit unlike anything she has ever attempted—but at what cost?

Episodes.Title: The Past Is the Past
Episodes.Description: Riri builds her most powerful suit yet, but she's unsure if it's enough to beat Parker and The Hood.

Entries.Title: House of David
Entries.Description: Tells the story of the ascent of the biblical figure, David, who becomes the most celebrated king of Israel. The series follows the once-mighty King Saul as he falls victim to his own pride. At the direction of God, the prophet Samuel anoints an unlikely, outcast teenager as the new king.

Episodes.Title: A Shepard and a King
Episodes.Description: One thousand years before Christ, Saul, the first King of Israel, loses God's grace and consequently also his own sanity. Meanwhile far away from the palace, the legendary seer Samuel becomes aware of a talented young shepherd named David. One of the greatest stories ever told is set in motion.

Episodes.Title: Deep Calls to Deep
Episodes.Description: Saul's family watches the King's deteriorating mental state with great concern, and is ready to do anything in their power to defend his reign. David is hungry for a life outside of his home, but what he finds beyond the hills of Bethlehem is danger beyond his wildest expectations.

Episodes.Title: The Anointing
Episodes.Description: The court must deal with the consequences of Saul's madness, Samuel is on the run from a sinister agent, and a nefarious shadow assembles a legendary ally in his plan to conquer Israel. Out in the fields of Bethlehem, David has an encounter that will change the course of history forever.

Episodes.Title: The Song of Moses
Episodes.Description: A member of the palace faces serious allegations, that force the royal family to react. Samuel suffers a grave loss and sees himself confronted with the consequences of his prophecy. David discovers a new world where he finds secrets, dangers, but above all, love.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf and the Lion
Episodes.Description: Queen Ahinoam hosts a feast to welcome an important group of guests in her home. The politics at court are full of deceit, and every player has their own secret mission. David learns to navigate his new life and comes one step closer to his destiny.

Episodes.Title: Giants Awakend
Episodes.Description: Dark powers strengthen outside Saul's kingdom as Israel's enemies summon legendary warriors that were long deemed myth. A relationship at court complicates the lives of the heroes severely and Queen Ahinoam must take drastic actions to help the King.

Episodes.Title: David and Goliath (1)
Episodes.Description: Kings, heroes and villains grapple for the crown in a final face-off. War is inevitable and on the ancient battlegrounds the players prepare for a colossal fight that will decide the fate of Israel forever.

Episodes.Title: David and Goliath (2)
Episodes.Description: An epic clash of forces puts a prophecy to a test. One of the most legendary battles in the history of mankind impends and the heroes must face their deadliest and mightiest foes yet. How will the monumental story unfold? Who will be victorious in the struggle for the kingdom?

Entries.Title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
Entries.Description: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

Episodes.Title: The Burger
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to find a healthy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

Episodes.Title: The Assistant
Episodes.Description: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic Al. As their relationship intensifies, the Al tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

Episodes.Title: The Distance
Episodes.Description: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

Episodes.Title: The Thing
Episodes.Description: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what "the thing" is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure.

Episodes.Title: The Butts
Episodes.Description: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

Episodes.Title: The Traffic
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

Episodes.Title: The Astrological
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Penny must stay together through the end of the school day to prove that they are meant to be together, despite an astrological prediction Mr. Small has made.

Episodes.Title: The Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to get Richard on the cheerleading team in order to end their family's generational trauma.

Episodes.Title: The Boring
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin use Molly's time-halting power (because she's so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

Episodes.Title: The Teacher
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

Episodes.Title: The App
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin must stop an evil social media app from turning every kid in Elmore into mindless internet-trend-following drones.

Episodes.Title: The Entrance
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year with the most praise-worthy entrance the world has ever seen.

Episodes.Title: The Letter
Episodes.Description: Darwin wants to get back a love letter he wrote to Carrie before she sees it.

Episodes.Title: The Gut
Episodes.Description: When Anais enlists her dad's help with her science project, Richard's GUT becomes its own brilliant thinking entity, separate from the original Richard we all know, and Anais must choose between the two.

Episodes.Title: The Wrinkle
Episodes.Description: Anais starts aging prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.

Episodes.Title: The Gourmet
Episodes.Description: After tasting Masami's gourmet, double-truffle mac-n-cheese at lunch, Gumball decides to do whatever it takes to get a full serving of the delicious meal.

Episodes.Title: The Pool
Episodes.Description: In the midst of a heatwave, Richard enlists Gumball, Darwin and Anais to assist him in his mission to jump in the Robinson's newly-installed above ground pool.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait
Episodes.Description: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone's entire face is in the photo and they're all smiling.

Episodes.Title: The Climb
Episodes.Description: Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall in gym class.

Episodes.Title: The Amadain
Episodes.Description: Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party with ease.

Entries.Title: Clevatess
Entries.Description: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess’s reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

Episodes.Description: An expedition of heroes challenges a powerful monster that keeps mankind trapped on a single continent.

Episodes.Title: The Beast Lord in Captivity
Episodes.Description: Alicia and Clevatess are captured by a group of foul bandits.

Episodes.Title: Hero's Duty
Episodes.Description: Nell is punished for her dreams of freedom.

Episodes.Title: Magical Talent
Episodes.Description: Clevatess and Alicia's time at the bandit camp nears its end.

Episodes.Description: Clevatess and Alicia are suddenly attacked by an unexpected opponent.

Entries.Description: Sophie trades city life for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

Episodes.Description: New to East Texas, Sophie O'Neil bonds with the alluring Margo Banks, who shows Sophie another side of life.

Episodes.Title: Knockin' Boots
Episodes.Description: Jed considers a run for governor. Margo aims to protect their privacy as the Hunting Wives navigate behind closed doors. The dead blond woman in the woods is found.

Episodes.Title: Sunrise Tells the Story
Episodes.Description: Margo has a surprise for Sophie and Callie's jealousy grows, as does Jill's concerns. A chilly discovery is made about the unidentified dead woman.

Episodes.Title: Cheat Day
Episodes.Description: After a body is discovered in the woods, tensions ignite as Margo and Brad rush to align their stories. Sophie searches for her missing handgun.

Episodes.Description: Determined to prove her innocence, Sophie searches for answers. Margo hits the campaign trail. Nina's fondness for Pete grows.

Episodes.Description: New information in Abby's murder investigation threatens to seal the fate of Sophie and the Hunting Wives. Starr discovers an unbearable truth.

Episodes.Title: Sophie's Choice
Episodes.Description: With Nina's safe return, Pete's suicide and Abby's killer shot dead, Sophie and Margo rest easy knowing the murder is solved, or so they think.

Entries.Title: Mandala Murders
Entries.Description: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 1
Episodes.Description: In 1950s Charandaspur, a ritual fails to reach its culmination. In the present day, ex-officer Vikram Singh probes a murder with missing body parts.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 2
Episodes.Description: Officer Rea travels to Charandaspur where she meets Ananya. Vikram confronts someone from his past. A masked figure lurks in the forest.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 3
Episodes.Description: Shastri, a shadow worshipper, reaches out to Rea with an ominous prediction. Vikram learns more about the mandala symbol and its meaning.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 4
Episodes.Description: Haunted by memories of his partner, Vikram teams up with Rea to decode eight mandalas linked to the murders — and to stop a harrowing attack.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 5
Episodes.Description: As Rea searches for the princess's identity, she opens up to Vikram about her fears. Ananya takes charge at home, while Jimmy cracks the next code.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 6
Episodes.Description: Vyankat's revelations leave Vikram shocked and furious. Upon learning that the next victim could be a child, Rea scrambles into rescue mode.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 7
Episodes.Description: In the 1950s, Nandini, a scientist, visits Charandaspur where she meets Rukmini, who brings a sinister warning. Later, she builds a wish-granting device.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 8
Episodes.Description: Vikram is kidnapped to be sacrificed to revive Yast. Can Rea follow in her grandmother's footsteps and stop the ritual before it's too late?

Entries.Title: We Were Liars
Entries.Description: One year after a mysterious accident left her with amnesia, 17-year-old Cadence returns to Beechwood, an island off Martha's Vineyard, seeking answers. As three generations of the distinguished Sinclair family gather at their private summer utopia, no one will talk about the accident – neither her childhood friends "The Liars" nor her first love Gat, forcing her to uncover the truth herself.

Episodes.Title: Tell Me Sweet Little Lies
Episodes.Description: Every summer, Cadence Sinclair cherishes her time with her cousins Mirren and Johnny and her best friend Gat on Beechwood Island. At sixteen, what begins as their usual summer of mischief transforms when Cadence and Gat fall in love, while adult tensions rise in her family. She doesn't know this fairy tale will end with her alone on the beach, injured and with no memory of how she got there.

Episodes.Title: Wrap Her Up in a Package of Lies
Episodes.Description: Following her mysterious accident, Cadence has suffered a year of illness, amnesia, and loneliness, having had no contact with The Liars. Returning to Beechwood for answers, she finds even her closest friends won't discuss the summer she can't remember. But the island begins triggering memories of Summer 16, starting with a Father's Day celebration marred by rivalry, betrayal, and heartbreak.

Episodes.Title: The Ties Were Black, the Lies Were White
Episodes.Description: Having remembered a family tragedy, Cadence presses The Liars for answers. Mirren reveals a crush gone awry, Johnny recalls an unwanted visitor, and Gat recounts their relationship's painful turn. Tension between the aunts continues to rise, and Cadence suspects at least one Liar is hiding something, questioning whether what happened last summer was an accident at all.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth of You Lie
Episodes.Description: As the Sinclairs prepare for a quiet Fourth of July, Cadence investigates one of The Liars, uncovering memories of last year's crowded celebration. While the Sinclair sisters vied for their father's approval, The Liars navigated their romantic lives and Ed surprised Carrie. In present day, Cadence discovers a shocking truth about one Liar, leading to a confrontation as explosive as the fireworks.

Episodes.Title: Lying Together in a Silver Lining
Episodes.Description: Unsettled by a series of painful memories, Cadence tries to enjoy what's left of her summer – even if it means distracting herself with a potentially dangerous stunt. Despite her best efforts, she remembers a stormy day from Summer 16 when rising seas and frustrations threatened every Sinclair, exposing the family's darker side and forcing Gat and Cadence to confront their unspoken feelings.

Episodes.Title: When Lies Gives You Lemons
Episodes.Description: Unable to continue keeping secrets from her, Gat finally opens up to Cadence about his perspective on the island – one that doesn't always reflect the fairy-tale nostalgia of her own experience. While they head into town in search of answers, Gat recounts his memories of an honored Sinclair tradition – Tipper's Lemon Hunt – and the unplanned visit from his mother that made him question everything.

Episodes.Title: Everybody Knows That the Captain Lied
Episodes.Description: More uncertain than ever, Cadence reluctantly joins Harris on an excursion, triggering memories of their final confrontation in Summer 16. During a tense family dinner, The Liars confront their mothers about family secrets. In the aftermath of shocking revelations, The Liars mourn their once-beloved childhood playground and unite in an attempt to save their fracturing family.

Episodes.Title: My Friends Are Lying in the Sun
Episodes.Description: Cadence devises a plan to trigger her latent memories of the final hours before her traumatic accident, but she can't do it alone – she must convince the reluctant Johnny, Mirren, and Gat to help her, even if it means risking everything. But as the truth begins to come back to her in fits and starts, Cadence realizes that she, herself, has been the biggest Liar of all.

Entries.Title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
Entries.Description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

Episodes.Title: Spring in a Heartbeat
Episodes.Description: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae-sun has dreams bigger than her village — until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Sassy First Love
Episodes.Description: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

Episodes.Title: Yesterday Was Your Spring
Episodes.Description: After a dramatic rescue, Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate — leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

Episodes.Title: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
Episodes.Description: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness — can they find a path to peace?

Episodes.Title: A Midsummer Night's Full Nets
Episodes.Description: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family — until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

Episodes.Title: Life Goes on and On
Episodes.Description: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything — testing their will to carry on.

Episodes.Title: A Fruitful Fall
Episodes.Description: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains
Episodes.Description: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

Episodes.Title: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
Episodes.Description: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

Episodes.Title: The Storm Sweeps My Heart, the Love Rocks My Heart
Episodes.Description: While Geum-myeong grows closer to her quirky colleague, Ae-sun's troubling dreams stir real concerns. Do they hold any meaning?

Episodes.Title: My Love by My Side
Episodes.Description: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt — will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

Episodes.Title: A Glistening Winter
Episodes.Description: Back in Jeju, Geum-myeong mends her heart in familiar surroundings. Ae-sun treasures sweet moments with her loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Such an Uneven Love
Episodes.Description: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face — sparking an unexpected new beginning.

Episodes.Title: Spread Your Wings and Fly
Episodes.Description: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

Episodes.Title: A Spring Every Day
Episodes.Description: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths — drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

Episodes.Title: Here's to All You've Been Through
Episodes.Description: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes — testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.

Entries.Title: Alien: Earth
Entries.Description: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

Episodes.Title: Neverland
Episodes.Description: When a spaceship crash-lands on Earth, a sister searches for her brother amidst an unexpected alien threat.

Episodes.Title: Mr. October
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise between rival corporations, a reunion takes place, and a secret is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Metamorphosis
Episodes.Description: The team returns home with unexpected cargo. An unsettling experiment occurs, and a new talent is discovered.

Episodes.Title: Observation
Episodes.Description: An unexpected connection is formed while a covert plot puts everyone in danger.

Episodes.Title: In Space, No One...
Episodes.Description: An outer-space vessel in peril leads to a dangerous reckoning.

Entries.Title: Trigger
Entries.Description: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: When a shocking mass shooting shatters Korea's calm, Lee Do races to stop the violence — then realizes the threat of illegal guns is just beginning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As shootings spread, Lee Do discovers guns in the hands of everyday citizens. When a victim hits close to home, his investigation grows more urgent.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A police raid uncovers a cache of military weapons. Lee Do and his new ally Moon Baek close in on the arms network as the city reels from bloodshed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Lee Do confronts a violent standoff and must decide how far to go to stop the killings, while suspicions about Moon Baek threaten their fragile alliance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Guns reach bullied students and grieving parents, sparking new tragedies. Lee Do uncovers a network delivering weapons to vulnerable people across Korea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A gun in the hands of a student spells crisis at school. As panic spreads, Lee Do and Moon Baek race rush to restore order — but it may be too late.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As fear and confusion grow, police and gangs rush to recover illegal guns. Lee Do feels powerless as the true scale of the arms crisis comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Police raid the gun syndicate, and rival gangs and old enemies clash in bloody battles. Lee Do is pushed to the limits as violence hits all of Korea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As guns reach new hands and fear sweeps the nation, Moon Baek's message echoes through the media. Across Korea, people must choose how to respond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: With emotions running high, Lee Do and Moon Baek move toward a crossroads. One final choice will shape Korea's future — or plunge it into darkness.

Entries.Title: Takopi's Original Sin
Entries.Description: A Happy alien, Takopi, lands on Earth with one mission: to spread happiness! When he meets Shizuka, a lonely fourth grader, he vows to bring back her smile using his magical Happy Gadgets. But as he uncovers the pain in her life, Takopi learns that true happiness may require more than gadgets.

Episodes.Title: To You in 2016
Episodes.Description: Shizuka lives a painful life until things start to take a sudden turn when she meets an alien named Takopi.

Episodes.Title: Takopi's Salvation
Episodes.Description: Takopi makes various attempts to help Shizuka, but things don't seem to work in his favor.

Episodes.Title: Takopi's Confession
Episodes.Description: Takopi realizes something important while covering up the crime with Shizuka and Naoki.

Episodes.Title: Azuma-kun's Salvation
Episodes.Description: Naoki struggles between his conscience and his desire to help Shizuka.

Episodes.Title: To You in 2022
Episodes.Description: Shizuka goes to Tokyo, and Takopi remembers something very important that happened in the past.

Episodes.Title: To All of You in 2016
Episodes.Description: Takopi makes an important decision that will save not only Shizuka but also Marina and Naoki.

Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Entries.Title: High Potential
Entries.Description: Morgan is a single mom with an exceptional mind, whose unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: A single mom with an exceptional mind is recruited to the LAPD Major Crimes unit, where her unconventional knack for solving crimes leads to an unusual and unstoppable partnership with a by-the-book seasoned detective.

Episodes.Title: Dancers in the Dark
Episodes.Description: As Morgan and the detectives adjust to her new role as a consultant, they investigate the attempted murder of a tap dancer and discover things are not quite as they seem. Meanwhile, Ava learns more about her father, and Morgan surprises her kids.

Episodes.Title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrel
Episodes.Description: Morgan's intellect and cleaning experience prove useful when the detectives are called to a hotel room murder scene, eventually uncovering the victim's many cons. Morgan navigates Ava's dating while Soto reveals details about Roman's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Survival Mode
Episodes.Description: Morgan is excited to get her official LAPD badge despite Karadec's reluctance. The detectives work tirelessly on an emotional missing children case, which hits close to home for Morgan and sends her mind into overdrive.

Episodes.Title: Croaked
Episodes.Description: The team investigates the death of an exotic animal veterinarian, uncovering a complicated love triangle in the process. Work interferes with Karadec's dating life, while Morgan follows a parental hunch about her teenage daughter and snoops on Ava.

Episodes.Title: Hangover
Episodes.Description: A wild office party at a high-profile medical technology startup leads to the shocking murder of the founder and CEO, and Morgan and the team are on the case. Meanwhile, a new co-worker at the precinct catches Morgan's eye.

Episodes.Title: One of Us
Episodes.Description: Morgan agrees to show Ava around the LAPD, but things quickly take a dangerous turn when the precinct is held hostage by the friends of a recently convicted man. Can Morgan and the detectives outsmart their captors and lead everyone to safety?

Episodes.Title: Obsessed
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a mysterious young girl who was found attacked on a beach. Meanwhile, Morgan begins to let her guard down on her date with Tom, and Soto comes one step closer to finding out what happened to Roman.

Episodes.Title: The RAMs
Episodes.Description: A famous baseball newscaster is murdered, and the team is on the case. Meanwhile, Soto and Morgan meet with a potential lead to discuss Roman's disappearance, and Tom has some personal news to share with Morgan.

Episodes.Title: Chutes and Murders
Episodes.Description: A nanny is found bludgeoned to death in the park. Elsewhere, Morgan interferes when Elliot admits to not being invited to his classmate’s party.

Episodes.Title: The Sauna at the End of the Stairs
Episodes.Description: Soto reopens an old murder case in the famous Donovan family, determined to uncover the true killer in classic “whodunit” style.

Episodes.Title: Partners
Episodes.Description: The FBI joins the investigation into the murder of a controversial tech magnate, forcing Karadec to reunite with his former partner. Meanwhile, Ludo becomes overwhelmed with his increasing childcare duties.

Episodes.Title: Let's Play
Episodes.Description: An anonymous tip to the LAPD sparks an unusual multiple-victim kidnapping investigation, forcing the team to rely on board games and puzzles to track down their suspect.
